audit.whatIsWrong: Row 6 (2+ items) reads Mordekaiser on both layers; the packet levelChart says Skill, and the page's own whys[6]/late text says the game becomes about her Glacial Prison landing on your carries, not the solo duel.
audit.why: Sejuani's late value is a 1300-range AOE stun on a 90s cooldown at rank 3; Mordekaiser still wins the isolated 1v1 but no longer decides the game alone. Rows 0-5 already match the packet.
audit.corrected: 2+ items = Skill on both layers; rows 0-5 unchanged.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Lvl 2-3 full kit + Darkness Rise, Lvl 6 Realm of Death (140/120/100s), 1st item Liandry's, and her Frost-stack stun window. All real.

audit.whatIsWrong: Permafrost is described only as 'her stun after Frost stacks' with no numbers and no trigger. Riot's text: Permafrost stuns only a champion at MAXIMUM Frost stacks; Winter's Wrath (W, 9/8/7/6/5s) is what applies those stacks. Permafrost's own 1.5s cooldown is meaningless — the W is the real clock.
audit.why: This converts vague 'bait her stun' advice into a concrete instruction: her W swing is the tell, so you commit after it, not before. Also missing: Arctic Assault (Q, 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s) is her only gap-closer and knockup, and Frost Armor grants slow immunity out of combat.
audit.corrected: Permafrost only fires at max Frost stacks, and Winter's Wrath builds them on a 9-5s cooldown — step in right after her W. Arctic Assault is her sole engage at 18-12s. Glacial Prison is a 1300-range projectile stun on 120/105/90s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags: NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere.
audit.why: The lane needs a stated wait-for-X-then-Y.
audit.corrected: Commit after her Winter's Wrath swing (9-5s) and while Arctic Assault (18-12s) is down.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sejuani is repeatedly called 'him'/'his' — tldr, winCon, report[0], report[1], report[8], report[11], dontsFull[0].t.
audit.why: Wrong-gender copy on a paid page reads as a template that was never checked.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected to her/she throughout the affected fields.

notes: Two things left untouched deliberately. (1) champ-data/_kits/mordekaiser.json puts a grounding flag ('shuts off enemy dashes') on Obliterate (Q). Riot's own description of Obliterate says nothing about grounding, so per the rules I trusted the description and did NOT write any claim that Morde's Q shuts off Arctic Assault — but that flag is almost certainly a tooltip-parsing misfire and will mislead other agents if left. (2) content.early, content.mid and content.late on this matchup are stored with doubled escaping — the on-disk values literally begin with a quote-backslash-quote sequence and render with visible \" characters. That is a data corruption bug, not a copy problem, so I did not attempt an edit whose before-string is that mangled; it needs fixing at the file level.
